property_summary: For any caller and amount, the owner-only sendMoney call from the contract should only succeed when invoked by the contract owner; the mutant inverts the check allowing non-owners to call owner-only functions and thus the behavior (success of sendMoney when called by owner) can differ for some inputs.
change_summary: Changed onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner, inverting the ownership check so only non-owners can call owner-protected functions like withdrawAll.
